title: Mutations and invalidation
objective: Use useMutation for writes, attach one logical idempotency key, and invalidate all affected query views after confirmed success.
predict: After a valid 201 POST, the task should appear in the refreshed todo list even when that list is separately cached from done/doing views.
expectedBehavior: Create with a valid key; verify one 201, then a GET refreshes the matching list. A 422 must never produce an invalidation-based success state.
commonFailure: The starter sends a POST without invalidating task-list queries and has no idempotency contract.
securityBoundary: A retry that regenerates the idempotency key may produce duplicate tasks. Avoid retrying unauthorized or validation failures automatically.
